inputPolicy: Fresh consumer graph and fresh copied test run output. Accepted owner/closure inputs are copied, hash-checked and never changed. No source owner rebuild is necessary to extend accepted byte-bound source-built owner evidence.
verifyOnly: Only --verify-only PAYLOAD is accepted; no timing, allocation or benchmark modes exist.
imageIdentityClarificationBeforeAnyCompi: Compile common consumer once and copy the exact same common DLL/PDB/deps/runtimeconfig into both variant run images. Inventory every image file with no fixture-prefix exclusion. The only possible future candidate-pair differences are Microsoft.AspNetCore.TestHost.dll and Microsoft.AspNetCore.TestHost.pdb; original/default dependency differences must be reported as a failing future owner-only identity gate, not excused.
acceptanceDoesNotProve: Any-vs-Count material gain, speedup, allocation difference, JIT inlining, or statistical significance
Concurrent mutation, invalid URI/null URI, all invalid/empty/null protocol strings, or cancellation races
A new live GitHub default observation while GitHub access is forbidden
candidatePolicy: No candidate patch is required or manufactured. A future narrow source edit and performance experiment need separate coordinator authorization.
